name: Tenjin Haruto
source:
Part of unit Eme☆Kare

The son of one of the wealthiest figures in Japan. He often sprinkles English into his sentences, is boundlessly cheerful, and very tolerant of others' interests.
He is childhood friends with Miake Sawa and Miwa Tomoe.
